en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Abu Usman, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Imam<sup>asws</sup> recognises the one who is to be (the Imam<sup>asws</sup>) after him<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> bequeaths to him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from (ibn) abu ‘Uthman from al-Mu‘alla ibn Khunays from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following “
The Imam (a.s.) knows the succeeding Imam and delivers his will to him.”
